## Known biases

None of these is a replacement value of an existing urban substation. MISO and B&amp;V price transmission substations on greenfield, flat, rural assumptions; the California guides price generator interconnection equipment; Con Edison&\#x27;s figures are forecasts for two large indoor New York City substations. Price years differ (2012 or earlier, 2023, 2024, 2025) and some are not stated; figures are reported as stated and are not adjusted. The latest MISO guide (MTEP26, June 2026) keeps its tables in a workbook that was not opened. No distribution (area) substation figure except Con Edison&\#x27;s Idlewild forecast was found.
